candidate.definition_en: To prepare a preliminary version of a text or plan; or to recruit someone for military service.
candidate.explanation_ar: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند شخصاً للخدمة العسكرية.

senses.definition_en: To write or draw a preliminary version of a document, plan, or law.
senses.explanation_ar: يكتب مسودة أو يصيغ وثيقة أو خطة بشكل مبدئي.
examples: I will draft a response to their email this afternoon.
They plan to draft a new contract before the end of the week.

senses.definition_en: To select someone for compulsory military service.
examples: The government decided not to draft college students into the army.
I will draft a response to their email this afternoon.
They plan to draft a new contract before the end of the week.
The government decided not to draft college students into the army.
candidate.mnemonic: فكر في مجلد الـ Drafts (المسودات) في بريدك الإلكتروني؛ لما تعمل draft لرسالة، يعني بتكتب مسودتها المبدئية قبل الإرسال النهائي.
